method.timestamps: Decimal microseconds converted to integer nanoseconds; never merge capture/rank timelines
method.cpu_inclusive: sum of durations for each exact operation name, not additive across nested names
method.cpu_exclusive: range duration minus union of strictly contained cpu_op ranges on same pid/tid; coincident ranges excluded and crossings counted; includes uninstrumented/greenlet suspension time
method.device_active: union of explicit compute task types on Ascend Hardware/Task Scheduler, excluding communication names
method.device_window: first compute kernel start to last compute kernel end; profiling enable/disable window also retained
method.forward_count: inferred from MoE/40, GDN/30, independently matching logits all-gather; no direct forward/layer timing exported
method.scope: diagnostic captures bounded to eight engine iterations; different number of executed model forwards, not a matched throughput benchmark
